text: The 1st Order of the Sentry is: To take charge of this post and all government property in view.

a: To take charge of this post and all government property in view.

source.title: NJROTC Cadet Reference Manual (CRM), Fourth Edition
source.publisher: Naval Service Training Command (NSTC), U.S. Navy

text: The 2nd Order of the Sentry is: To walk my post in a military manner, keeping always on the alert, and observing everything that takes place within sight or hearing.
q: What is the 2nd Order of the Sentry?
a: To walk my post in a military manner, keeping always on the alert, and observing everything that takes place within sight or hearing.

source.title: NJROTC Cadet Reference Manual (CRM), Fourth Edition
source.publisher: Naval Service Training Command (NSTC), U.S. Navy

text: The 3rd Order of the Sentry is: To report all violations of orders I am instructed to enforce.

text: The 4th Order of the Sentry is: To repeat all calls from any post more distant from the guardhouse (quarterdeck) than my own.

source.title: NJROTC Cadet Reference Manual (CRM), Fourth Edition
source.publisher: Naval Service Training Command (NSTC), U.S. Navy

text: The 5th Order of the Sentry is: To quit my post only when properly relieved.

text: The 7th Order of the Sentry is: To talk to no one except in the line of duty.
